items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And Mr. TischeaeR told me that he was a very fine guitarist

ctx.x: And Mr. TischeaeR told me that he was a very fine guitarist, so I heard him and taken him right after we opened.
And so we opened -- there was something very funny about the opening. I arrived with the orchestra naturally for an artist's rehearsal.
